name: whole_body_tripod_step_in_place_v1
description: Whole-body ALTERNATING TRIPOD foot stepping IN PLACE from the champion stand pose (final tick of rl_stand_20260812_145534.csv, the same pose champion_stand_ground_v1 ends on and whole_body_single_leg_lift_v1 and tripod_weight_shift_static_v1 use as home). Purpose: the first measurement of a THREE-FEET-AT-ONCE swing -- whether a tripod can leave the ground together and land repeatably without tilt runaway or a current spike, measured separately from any forward motion. Stepping in place removes body translation and foot slip so the vertical load-transfer cost of the tripod swing is isolated. Sequence at 25 Hz: 3 s settle at the six-foot stand, then six alternating cycles; each cycle lifts tripod A (L0,L2,L4) 15 mm over 1.2 s, holds 0.8 s clear, lowers 1.2 s down the same path, dwells 1.0 s on all six feet, then does exactly the same for tripod B (L1,L3,L5). 53.4 s total (1335 ticks) -- 3 s settle plus twelve 4.2 s half-cycles; the plan's '~55 s' is nominal. THREE FEET ARE OFF THE GROUND AT ONCE and never more: the other three legs hold the stand pose exactly, the two tripods never overlap, and the trajectory starts and ends at the full six-foot stand. NO HIP-YAW MOTION AND NO BODY TRANSLATION AT ALL -- yaw is fixed at the stand value on every leg and the 15 mm is a pure VERTICAL foot displacement at constant radial reach, solved with the repo's two-link IK (safe_zero.ik_hip_knee), moving hip ~-10.9 deg and knee ~+1.8 deg per leg; radial drift is <0.02 mm (2-decimal joint rounding) so each lifted foot goes straight up and comes straight back down onto its own footprint. Peak joint rate ~13.6 deg/s, well under the default 400 counts/s (~35 deg/s) profile speed. Soft torque 700; loaded current budget 2.0 A tripping after three consecutive readings above it; hard ceiling 3.0 A. Robot ON THE GROUND (unsupported), operator watching, hands ready; requires force=true.
